explanation: Three days in Sydney with cached, provider-routed connections: airport train, harbour walks, a park cycle loop, Bondi by car and bus, and the Manly ferry. Schedules are illustrative; the hotel is suggested and not booked.
warnings: Transport fares, bike hire, meals and admission prices are unverified and excluded from the activity estimate.
Driving legs assume taxi or rideshare, not a booked vehicle.
Cycling assumes returning a hired bike to the same location. Check availability, access and local conditions.
Hotel room rate, availability, luggage storage and check-in arrangements are unconfirmed. No bookings were made.
No flight is selected. Airport arrival is an estimate; check your flight and required airport buffer before using this itinerary.

trace.title: Provider-routed Demo connections
trace.detail: Every road segment is cached from FOSSGIS / OSM; rail, bus and ferry shapes plus station access are from TfNSW. Road endpoints and handovers must be within 3 metres. Vehicle-to-pavement boarding links are explicitly estimated and limited to 20 metres. Hotel marker is the mapped Pitt Street public approach, not an interior doorway.
trace.source: FOSSGIS / OpenStreetMap; Transport for NSW / Trip Planner
